title: ping++ Project Tasks
description: Task management for ping++ network fingerprinting tool

tasks.title: PHASE 1: Project Setup and Foundation
tasks.description: Initialize project structure, Go module, and core interfaces
tasks.details: Set up the ping++ project with proper Go module structure, define core interfaces following ProjectDiscovery patterns, and create the foundation for the modular probe system.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify all subtasks are completed, go build ./... succeeds, and project structure matches plan.

subtasks.title: Create project folder from template
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify projects/ping++/ directory exists with correct structure.

subtasks.title: Complete PRD.txt with requirements
subtasks.testStrategy: PRD.txt has all sections filled with specific requirements.

subtasks.title: Create ping++-tasks.json
subtasks.description: Create detailed task breakdown following JSON Schema
subtasks.testStrategy: JSON validates against schema, all tasks have required fields.

subtasks.title: Initialize Go module (go.mod)
subtasks.description: Create go.mod with module path and dependencies
subtasks.testStrategy: go mod tidy succeeds without errors.

subtasks.title: Define Probe interface
subtasks.testStrategy: Interface compiles, is documented with godoc comments.

subtasks.title: Define Options struct
subtasks.testStrategy: Options struct compiles, matches ProjectDiscovery patterns.

subtasks.title: Define Result types
subtasks.testStrategy: Result type compiles, can be converted to sirius.Host.

subtasks.title: Create Runner skeleton
subtasks.testStrategy: go build ./... succeeds, Runner can be instantiated.

tasks.title: PHASE 2: Core Probes
tasks.description: Implement ICMP, TCP probes and TTL-based OS detection
tasks.testStrategy: All probes work independently, TTL detection correctly identifies Linux vs Windows.

subtasks.title: Implement ICMP probe
subtasks.description: Create pkg/probes/icmp/icmp.go with ICMP Echo probe
subtasks.testStrategy: Ping localhost returns Success=true with TTL value.

subtasks.title: Implement TCP SYN probe
subtasks.testStrategy: Probe detects open port 80 on a web server.

subtasks.title: Implement TTL-based OS detection
subtasks.testStrategy: TTL 64 returns 'linux', TTL 128 returns 'windows', TTL 255 returns 'cisco'.

subtasks.title: Implement result aggregation
subtasks.testStrategy: Multiple probe results combine into single Result with best OS determination.

tasks.title: PHASE 3: Advanced Probes
tasks.description: Implement ARP and SMB probes for enhanced detection
tasks.testStrategy: ARP probe returns MAC addresses on local network, SMB probe returns Windows version hints.

subtasks.title: Implement ARP probe
subtasks.testStrategy: Local network scan returns MAC addresses for discovered hosts.

subtasks.title: Implement SMB probe
subtasks.testStrategy: Windows host returns OS version hint from SMB response.

tasks.title: PHASE 4: Runner and Integration
tasks.description: Complete Runner implementation and app-scanner integration
tasks.testStrategy: Runner scans multiple hosts concurrently, app-scanner uses ping++ for fingerprinting.

subtasks.title: Implement Runner with worker pool
subtasks.testStrategy: Concurrent scan of 10 hosts completes without race conditions.

subtasks.title: Implement OnResult callback system
subtasks.description: Wire up OnResult callback in Runner
subtasks.testStrategy: OnResult callback receives each result as scan completes.

subtasks.title: Implement FingerprintStrategy adapter
subtasks.testStrategy: Strategy implements FingerprintStrategy interface, returns valid FingerprintResult.

subtasks.title: Verify go-api type compatibility
subtasks.testStrategy: Result.ToSiriusHost() returns valid sirius.Host struct.

tasks.title: PHASE 5: CLI and Polish
tasks.description: Implement CLI, documentation, tests, and CI/CD
tasks.testStrategy: CLI works, tests pass, documentation is complete, CI/CD runs successfully.

subtasks.title: Implement CLI with goflags
subtasks.testStrategy: pingpp -t 127.0.0.1 runs successfully and outputs results.

subtasks.title: Add JSON output format
subtasks.testStrategy: -json flag outputs valid JSON lines.

subtasks.title: Create library usage example
subtasks.testStrategy: Example compiles and runs successfully.

subtasks.title: Write unit tests
subtasks.testStrategy: go test ./... passes with >80% coverage.

subtasks.title: Set up CI/CD pipeline
subtasks.testStrategy: GitHub Actions workflow runs successfully on push.

subtasks.title: Update README documentation
subtasks.testStrategy: README has all sections, examples are accurate.

subtasks.title: Project cleanup and handoff
subtasks.testStrategy: All tasks completed, integration verified, clean git status.
